steps.title: movement
steps.content: Use the north, south, east, west commands to move around

steps.title: combat
steps.content: During a fight you can attack, defend, or use items

steps.title: Interacting
steps.content: Use 'examine', 'talk', 'pick_up' to interact with the environment

steps.title: inventory
steps.content: Check your inventory to manage items and equipment

steps.title: Starting a Fight
steps.content: Fights begin when you encounter an enemy or attack someone

steps.title: Turns
steps.content: Combat unfolds in turns, in which you choose an action

steps.title: attack
steps.content: A basic attack uses your equipped weapon against an enemy

steps.title: defense
steps.content: Defending reduces the damage you take on the next turn

steps.title: items
steps.content: You can use potions or other items during combat

steps.title: Abilities
steps.content: Special abilities depend on your class and consume mana

steps.title: Picking Up Items
steps.content: Use 'pick_up [item]' to add an item to your inventory

steps.title: Equipping
steps.content: Use 'equip [item]' to wear or wield an item

steps.title: Using Items
steps.content: Use 'use [item]' to consume or activate an item

steps.title: Examining
steps.content: Use 'examine [item]' to get details about an item

steps.title: Talking to NPCs
steps.content: Use 'talk [NPC name]' to start a conversation

steps.title: Dialogue Options
steps.content: Select the numbered options to reply during conversations

steps.title: Trade
steps.content: Some NPCs offer options to buy or sell items

steps.title: quests
steps.content: By talking to NPCs you can receive quests to complete
